scripts.setup: uv sync --directory apps/api --dev && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix packages/contracts ci
scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api uvicorn debate_api.main:app --app-dir src --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:api && npm run type-check:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --directory apps/api python ../../scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --prefix packages/contracts run generate
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/generated/api.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run contracts:check
